name: MongoDB Community Server
description: Advanced document database server with flexible JSON-like documents.
longDescription: MongoDB is a document-oriented database. DevForge installs MongoDB Community Server through WinGet and verifies the Windows service and mongod binary. MongoDB starts without authentication for local development; enabling authentication requires you to create admin users yourself.
caveats: MongoDB starts without authentication by default. For anything beyond local development, enable authentication and create dedicated admin users.
DevForge does not create, store or log database credentials.
Uninstalling does not delete your data files. Back up your databases before removing the server.
The MSI installs for all users and Windows will request administrator permission.
